state: Goal `core-str-2-3`: `Core\Str::graphemes`, `indexOf`, `isEmpty`, `join` and `lastIndexOf` are complete (`bun nv proofs --id` says so for each). `lastIndexOf` and `before`/`after` with `{last: true}` now search backwards through `rfind_from`, so their cost is linear in the text. The old forward scan cost the text's length times the needle's when a long needle matched at many positions. Every `Core\Str` bench record is re-measured after that change. The `2/3` check still names `lines`, `lower`, `lowerFirst`, `normalize`, `padEnd`, `padStart`, `repeat` and `replace` with no proofs. Gap `nvs-stdlib/a-match-inside-a-character-reports-the-wrong-position` (owner M11) is open for the search family. A change to the code of `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/str.rs` makes every `Core\Str` perf record stale. Re-measure them all with `bun nv proofs --record-perf --only …` in the same session; `--force` re-measures one whose record the tool thinks is current. A card or test edit does not make a record stale.

**`Core\Str::lowerFirst`** — the same proofs, and the same Rust tests. `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/str.rs:564`
